scope: Independent non-author review of committed source identity, serial benchmark orchestration, timeout failure evidence, workflow permissions and compatibility with the actual existing runner CLIs.
static_checks: Manifest bytes must equal HEAD's committed blob and the checkout must be clean. Baseline is a full existing ancestor commit, candidate is exact HEAD/event SHA, and the candidate crates tree is explicitly checked. Rust, LLVM, seed and paired-block requirements are checked before installation/measurement.

Test groups restrict package names, feature values and existing target identifiers. LLVM-related tests must enable llvm-api; required integration controls and types library tests cannot be omitted. Selected harnesses must each report nonzero passing execution, not merely cargo exit success.

Both release compilers are built from the declared commits in separate Cargo target directories. Exact binary hashes and build commands are retained before only those disposable target directories are removed.

Compiler builds, candidate format/check/tests and Python runner tests all finish before matrix execution. Commands and measurement windows execute synchronously; there is no background compiler build, parallel measurement matrix or favorable-window retry/selection.

The five-case weights, three paired blocks and request weights are checked after each plan preparation. The O0 bridge keeps no-query LLVM API/no-timings behavior; query-enabled Rust incremental is separately named. Rust primary windows explicitly preserve native CGU/linker/LTO policy. The direct O2 quality window explicitly compares baseline closed 1/1 with candidate closed 8/4.

All orchestration argv/cwd, command logs, return status and hashes are retained. Existing runner validation remains responsible for full measured argv, source/tool/environment identity, oracle checks, row coverage and completion receipts. Overall completion remains exploratory with product gates and performance adoption unaccepted.

A command exhausting the monotonic budget kills its descendant process tree, records failure and suppresses the overall score. Previously completed windows and partial logs remain in the evidence directory; a file-hash inventory is generated on normal error handling.

Workflow permissions are contents:read; checkout uses persist-credentials:false. No token is explicitly injected, no credential/config directory is packaged, and no write-back step exists. Fixed action commits, same-branch concurrency and serial steps are present.

Packaging retains the evidence tree and binary modes in tar.gz plus hashes and setup/install receipts. Compiler target caches are excluded. Hard runner loss or cancellation still depends on GitHub's artifact-upload opportunity and is not a completed measurement.

The exact runner source parses successfully, git diff --check passes, and all orchestration runner flags match the current bench.py/rust_bench.py/runtime_bench.py interfaces. These dependencies were unchanged at the observed integrated HEAD 42dc0423f8d673b018451cfdd57b8987f24feeaf.

integration_requirements.detail: The CP17 validator requires the types library but permits a backend group with lib:false; its original documentation example does so. The actual run manifest must select zil-backend-llvm lib:true so CP14's 2047/2048/2049 machine-model boundary tests execute. The integrator has confirmed this manifest/documentation correction; inspect the committed final manifest before treating targeted tests as complete.

Bind the final committed manifest, equivalent published runner tree, exact candidate crates tree and actual Actions run/artifact. A static review of this orchestration commit does not bind a later source candidate by itself.

timeout_microcontrol.scope: One isolated Python command with a child in another session, using the exact CP17 Run.command/finish source and a one-second budget. No Rust/LLVM build or performance measurement.
timeout_microcontrol.command_result: Fail with timeout:true and nonzero exit, as required
timeout_microcontrol.descendant_result: Terminated; descendant process absent after return

limitations: GitHub CPU affinity and sequential subprocesses do not prove exclusive access to physical host resources; the output correctly retains exploratory status.

A passing runtime summary establishes complete correct measurements, not runtime nonregression. The integrator must independently assess each corpus and cannot accept CP14/CP15 by the orchestration completion flag alone.
This entrypoint runs native primary Rust windows. CP16 off-mode diagnostics require their own separate plans if requested; no off-mode performance result is implied.
